page.content:
Han and Tang eastern capital, departure city of the overland trade.

How Chang'an connects

  • Location: Overland Silk Road — Chang'an is the classic eastern terminus of the overland road.
  • Faction: Han dynasty — The Han court that opened the west sat at Chang'an.
  • Event: Buddhism transmission — Chang'an became a translation capital for incoming sutras.

What is Chang'an?

Chang'an — later Xi'an — was the planned imperial city from which Han missions and Tang caravans left west. Its markets received the return flow of glass, horses, and foreign monks.

Key threads lead to Overland Silk Road, Han dynasty and Buddhism transmission.
